player_prompt.intro:
Uyimdlali {player_id} kuSimpleTak.
Kwibhoja, amathambo ao azibonakala njengama-'{player_stone}' na amathambo amdlali wakho azibonakala njengama-'{opponent_stone}'.

Kwingxelo lakho, khetha yiceli epheleleyo (ngenombolo yakho) futha wathabatha lithambo lakho lapha.
Njengoko, '[12]' lithabathe lithambo lakho kwi selu 12.

Injongo yakho iyakukwazisa ukuzisa kwamathambo akho ngokuthi kuwe ngamaphatho angajikeleza amathambo akho angaqhuba amaphepha amabini angaphaya kwebhoja (phezulu-kwapha kwaye ntshona-nxenkeme).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Inombolo yeceli engavunyikiwa {cell_num}. Ingakufuneka ibe phakathi kwama-0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Iseli {cell_num} sele igcwele. Khetha iseli engenanto.

action.placement: Mdlali {current_player_id} wathabatha isithetho sayo ({symbol}) kwi selu {cell_num}.

outcome.draw: The board is full. It's a draw!
